title: PMKSY Completes 10 Years of Sustainable Irrigation; Cabinet Approves M-CADWM Sub-Scheme
summary: Allocates ₹6,587 crore in Budget 2026-27 for micro-irrigation under Per Drop More Crop.

blocks.content: Allocates ₹6,587 crore in Budget 2026-27 for micro-irrigation under Per Drop More Crop.

items: PMKSY Overview: Launched July 1, 2015; continued for 2021-26 with ₹93,068.56 crore outlay (benefited 27M+ farmers).
Per Drop More Crop (PDMC): 110.92 lakh hectares brought under micro-irrigation.
M-CADWM Sub-Scheme: Cabinet approved Modernization of Command Area Development & Water Management with ₹1,600 crore initial outlay for pipeline networks.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Ministry of Jal Shakti | PMKSY-AIBP completed 71 of 123 major irrigation projects.
